modos.descricao: Policial com Firearm. Descarta equipamento nao-fetich

_metadata.texto_original: Police. The Fomori Cop is armed with a firearm. If disarmed, his Rage becomes 3. At the end of the Combat Phase, the Cop discards a piece of non-fetish Equipment equipped by a Gaia creature (chosen by a random player).
_metadata.notas: Descarte de equipamento e disarm requerem implementacao no motor.
